name: Webcams
description: Live webcam streams and traffic cameras

content.urlOffline: This webcam URL appears to be offline or no longer available.

windy.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates via backend; browser loads Windy player/media directly when a live or timelapse embed is opened
windy.dataReceived: Webcam clusters/points with name, coordinates, thumbnail URL, stream URL, view count, categories

osm.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates via Overpass API
osm.dataReceived: OSM nodes with webcam URL, name, operator, direction

us-ca-caltrans.dataSent: No user data (fetches district datasets, filtered server-side to bounding box)
us-ca-caltrans.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with location, name, still image URL, route/direction

gb-eng-tfl.dataSent: No user data for catalog fetch; browser loads TfL video media directly when the video clip is displayed
gb-eng-tfl.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with name, coordinates, still image URL, video URL

us-nps.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire webcam catalog with pagination, filtered server-side to bounding box)
us-nps.dataReceived: Webcams with title, coordinates, image URL, streaming status, related park name/state, tags

us-ny-511.dataSent: No user data for catalog fetch; browser loads 511NY HLS media directly when the live stream is opened
us-ny-511.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with name, coordinates, snapshot URL, HLS video stream URL, roadway name, direction of travel

us-or-tripcheck.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire camera inventory, filtered server-side to bounding box)
us-or-tripcheck.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with title, coordinates, still image URL, route name

us-ga-511.dataSent: API key (fetches entire camera list, filtered server-side to bounding box)
us-ga-511.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with name, coordinates, snapshot URL, roadway, direction

fi-digitraffic-webcam.dataSent: No user data; the server fetches active stations and proxies the selected still image
fi-digitraffic-webcam.dataReceived: Camera stations with coordinates, image identifier and update time

se-trafikverket.dataSent: Operator API key in a server-side XML request
se-trafikverket.dataReceived: Camera names, coordinates, image URLs, road and direction

no-npra.dataSent: Operator DATEX credentials in a server-side HTTP Basic request
no-npra.dataReceived: CCTV site metadata, coordinates, image URLs, road and direction

is-road-administration.purpose: Iceland road cameras (Road and Coastal Administration)
is-road-administration.dataSent: No user data; the full public catalog is fetched server-side and filtered to the map area
is-road-administration.dataReceived: Camera names, coordinates, road description and still-image URL

es-dgt-webcam.purpose: Spain state-road traffic cameras (DGT DATEX II)
es-dgt-webcam.dataSent: No user data; the public DATEX catalog and displayed still images are fetched through the server
es-dgt-webcam.dataReceived: Camera identifiers, coordinates, road/destination and image URL

ca-ontario.dataSent: No user data; the public camera catalog and displayed still images are fetched through the server
ca-ontario.dataReceived: Camera names, coordinates, roadway, direction and snapshot URL

hk-transport.dataSent: No user data; the public camera-location catalog and displayed still images are fetched through the server
hk-transport.dataReceived: Camera identifiers, coordinates, district, description and snapshot URL

au-nsw-webcam.purpose: New South Wales live traffic cameras
au-nsw-webcam.dataSent: Operator API key in a server-side request
au-nsw-webcam.dataReceived: Camera GeoJSON with name, coordinates, road, suburb and image URL

tw-tdx-webcam.dataSent: Operator OAuth credentials are exchanged server-side; an external live stream is loaded only after user consent
tw-tdx-webcam.dataReceived: CCTV identifiers, coordinates, road/direction and image or stream URL
